fixtures.configuration_policy: Only content/rules revision labels are consumed from server.valid.json; simulation/snapshot/disconnect settings do not schedule this finite probe.
fixtures.scope: Test-only local probe processing ticks; serialized payload bytes for logical test recipients. No wire, database or capacity measurement.

measurements.scope: Test-only local probe processing ticks; serialized payload bytes for logical test recipients. No wire, database or capacity measurement.
measurements.clock_policy: FPlatformTime::Seconds monotonic start before FIFO drain; end after decision, payload encoding and hashing; excludes report capture. UTC context is simulated time, not elapsed time.
measurements.payload_policy: FContentContracts::Encode JSON, UTF-8 without BOM, terminator or added newline; exact retained text hashed with SHA-1. No transport headers, retransmission, compression or socket traffic.
measurements.entity_policy: Count of visible_entities in the pinned empty-world context; queued effects and logical recipients are not entities.
measurements.summary_policy: All captured processing ticks: arithmetic mean and maximum milliseconds, FIFO maximum over before/after-drain/after-step, payload byte sums per logical recipient. Empty window has null duration statistics; no recipients has an empty byte map.
